description:
A leading U.S. call analytics company is seeking a Senior Data Management Engineer to drive innovation, harness the power of data, and deliver actionable insights to clients. In this impactful role, you will design scalable systems, build dynamic user interfaces, and enhance real-time analytics tools, enabling businesses to make smarter, faster decisions.

As part of the Product Engineering Team, you’ll collaborate across disciplines to develop robust APIs, high-performance data pipelines, and cutting-edge UIs, merging full-stack development with data platform engineering. Your work will shape the future of call analytics and customer engagement.

Key Responsibilities

  • API & Microservices Development : Design and maintain scalable APIs and microservices for real-time data ingestion, processing, and analytics, leveraging Azure cloud-native technologies (e.g., Azure Functions, Event Hubs, Cosmos DB).
  • Data Pipeline Optimization : Collaborate with data engineers to build and refine real-time data pipelines using Azure Data Explorer, Snowflake, and Kafka/Confluent.
  • ETL and Data Integration : Create efficient ETL workflows and perform complex data ingestion and transformation using .NET/C#, SQL, and PySpark.
  • Data Architecture & Storage : Design and manage data lakes and storage solutions using Azure Data Lake, Parquet, and Delta Tables.
  • Real-Time Processing : Work with big data and real-time data processing frameworks to support high-volume analytics.
  • Legacy System Modernization : Lead the migration of legacy platforms to a centralized "data of record" system, ensuring data integrity, eliminating redundancy, and improving operational efficiency.
  • Pipeline Innovation : Develop configurable pipelines via APIs to support real-time omnichannel conversational analytics and integration with tools like Twilio.
  • Performance Optimization : Optimize data processing and storage solutions for scalability, cost-efficiency, and high performance.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or advanced degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent professional experience).
  • 5+ years of experience in full-stack development, specializing in data-driven platforms and scalable systems.
  • Expertise in C# and .NET technologies (preferably .NET 8).
  • Proficiency with Azure cloud services (e.g., Data Explorer, Functions, Event Hubs, Cosmos DB).
  • Hands-on experience with Snowflake and optimizing data pipelines for real-time analytics.
  • Familiarity with real-time messaging systems like Kafka/Confluent .
  • Advanced knowledge of modern web frameworks such as React , Angular , or Vue.js .
  • Experience in building and consuming RESTful APIs and working with microservices architectures .
  • Strong background in data ingestion , ETL workflows , and real-time analytics pipelines .
  • Proven skills in query performance optimization and efficient data processing.

Preferred Skills

  • Experience with Java or Scala is a plus.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD tools like Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions.
  • Understanding of Agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban).

About Us

Nu was born in 2013 with the mission to fight complexity to empower people in their daily lives by reinventing financial services. We are one of the world’s largest digital banking platforms, serving millions of customers across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia.

Nubank’s continued success hinges on our Platform Product Managers, who play a crucial role in recognizing and solving important customer problems at scale. This role is vital as it synthesizes our broader business strategy with the needs of development teams across the company. By building products that create leverage for our business, these managers simplify and scale capabilities to unlock potential and mitigate risks. Their work impacts our core cloud architecture, data infrastructure, finance, security platforms, customer service tools, and other internal products. They own the goal of equipping Nubank to meet evolving customer needs for decades.

You will be responsible for

  • Defining, prioritizing, and communicating both short and long-term product goals.
  • Developing a deep understanding of users and stakeholders through research, data analysis, and interviews.

  • Staying updated on complex areas like cloud services and information security to guide the team.
  • Acting as an evangelist, ensuring clear communication between the team and stakeholders to bridge understanding gaps.

We are looking for a person who has

  • Experience working with software products as a Product Manager or a similar role.
  • Robust experience managing the entire product life-cycle for successful tech products.
  • A strong desire to discover and fulfill user needs.
  • Confidence in working with numbers and data-driven decision-making.
  • The ability to build strong relationships with diverse stakeholders.
  • An aptitude for turning incomplete or conflicting information into actionable plans.
  • Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with proficiency in presentation.
  • Advanced English proficiency.

In this role, you will be required to understand our integration APIs (Amazon Marketplace Web Service - MWS and SP-APIs), which is an integrated web service that helps sellers programmatically exchange on listings, orders, payments, reports, and more.

Job functions include:

  1. Be responsible for a group of partners and manage the pipeline of projects.
  2. Daily/weekly contact with their teams via phone and email and also make recurrent visits.

  5. Understand seller API documentation and interact with their teams to deeply understand our APIs, follow guidelines, and/or ask for support when complex problems are found.

  7. Be a technical consulting expert to the Product Manager on evaluating the best solution, estimating efforts, and defining the product roadmap.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

Somos o Grupo Energisa! Com mais de cem anos de história, a Energisa é o maior grupo privado com controle 100% nacional do setor elétrico brasileiro. Nosso portfólio diversificado abrange distribuidoras, concessões de transmissão, geração de grande porte renovável, uma marca inovadora de soluções energéticas – a (re)energisa –, com geração distribuída por fonte renovável, comercialização de energia no mercado livre e serviços de valor agregado, além de uma central de serviços compartilhados, uma empresa de contact center e a fintech Voltz, a primeira do nosso setor no mercado de contas digitais. Recentemente, diversificamos nosso portfólio com a inclusão da distribuição de gás natural, através da aquisição da ES Gás. Transformamos, através de nossos mais de 17.000 colaboradores, energia em conforto e desenvolvimento para mais de 20 milhões de pessoas. Acreditamos na força da diversidade e da pluralidade para gerar inovação e atingir resultados incríveis. Aqui todos são muito bem-vindos! Quer fazer parte desta história?   4. Garantir o cumprimento dos procedimentos operacionais e de execução;

Energia que impulsiona o Brasil. Talentos que fazem a diferença. Venha fazer parte do Grupo Energisa!

Sabia que somos um dos maiores grupos do setor elétrico brasileiro? Com 120 anos de história, somos um ecossistema de produtos e serviços voltado para liderar a transformação energética, conectando pessoas e empresas à melhor solução de energia e construindo um mundo mais sustentável. Atuamos em 977 municípios, levando energia a mais de 20 milhões de pessoas.

Nosso trabalho mais visível é na distribuição de energia, mas temos muito mais a oferecer. Além das distribuidoras e concessões de transmissão, contamos com geração fotovoltaica centralizada e uma das maiores parques de geração distribuída do país, com a marca (re)energisa. Operamos também no Mercado Livre de Energia, oferecendo soluções de valor agregado.

Diversificamos nosso portfólio com distribuição e comercialização de gás natural, aquisição da ES Gás, e participação nos ativos da Cegás, Copergás, Algás e Potigás. Investimos em bio soluções como biogás, biometano e biofertilizante, através da Agric.

Nossa missão é transformar energia em conforto, desenvolvimento e possibilidades com sustentabilidade. Contamos com cerca de 17 mil colaboradores que fazem a diferença todos os dias.

description:
Introduction
Thomas J. Watson said it best: “Good design is good business.” Visualization is critical to discovering data-driven insights and effectively communicating that knowledge to others. Designers at IBM work to create experiences that work together, work the same, and work for our clients. Does the thought of creating the platform at the heart of solutions like Watson, Blockchain, IoT, and Security excite you? If so, read on!
Your Role and Responsibilities

  • Lead UX initiatives, delivering scalable, innovative solutions aligned with user-centered design principles and key business goals.
  • Showcase expert design craft yourself while inspiring others on your team to deliver with high quality, efficiency, and impact.
  • Advocate for inclusive design and accessibility (WCAG standards), ensuring that all designs are usable by diverse audiences and meet the highest standards of accessibility.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with product managers, developers, and other stakeholders to create cohesive, end-to-end user experiences.
  • Rapidly design and prototype concepts, wireframes, and interactive flows using your expert Figma skills (if you can’t build and use Figma components in your sleep, this may not be the role for you).
  • Cultivate an engaging creative culture within the cross-disciplinary design team, ensuring that diverse voices and perspectives are valued and integrated into the design process. (We believe our designs are stronger when iterated together.)
  • Mentor and inspire junior designers, fostering growth and promoting best practices in design.
  • Contribute to implementing and maintaining the IBM Carbon Design System for AEM across projects, ensuring adherence to brand and UI best practices.
  • Actively share and refine ideas within the team, embracing feedback early and often to iterate towards target design outcomes.
  • Own and project manage large-scale initiatives including design deliverables (such as concepts, wireframes, interactive prototypes, specifications, etc.), integration with research, collaboration with visual design/animation, and coordination with large-scale project timelines.

Required Technical and Professional Expertise
  • Please submit your resume in English with your portfolio.
  • Expert in Figma: You can create and manage complex component libraries and interactive prototypes with ease.
  • Proven experience as a UX designer with a strong portfolio showcasing your inclusive and user-centered design approach across web and mobile.
  • Strong knowledge of accessibility standards (WCAG) and inclusive design practices, with a commitment to designing for diverse user needs.
  • Solid understanding of usability principles, information architecture, and human-centered design.
  • Experience working with design systems and the ability to quickly adapt to IBM’s Carbon Design System and branding guidelines.
  • Exceptional communication, collaboration, and relationship management skills to work effectively across time zones and cultural contexts.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage design deliverables, timelines, and engagement agreements.
  • Innovative and collaborative mindset, adaptable to fast-paced, ever-evolving creative environment.
  • Familiarity with data-driven design using tools like GA4, Medallia, or Adobe Analytics.
  • Fluent level of English

Preferred Technical and Professional Expertise
  • Experience with Adobe Experience Manager (AEM).
  • Knowledge of current UX trends and ability to drive innovative, user-centered solutions from concept to launch.
  • Proven track record of contributing to an inclusive and collaborative team culture, fostering trust, motivation, and creativity.
  • Experience working in cross-functional, global teams with flexibility for virtual and in-person collaboration.

ATENÇÃO

Somente para candidato(a) com experiência.

Para esta vaga é necessário ter experiência prévia mínima de 3 anos em departamento fiscal, rotinas fiscais de empresas enquadradas no lucro presumido e no lucro real.

Missão

Como Analista Fiscal você desempenhará um papel vital na análise e otimização de processos fiscais e procedimentos, identificando riscos tributários associados às operações fiscais. Seu trabalho resultará em um aumento de eficiência e precisão nas atividades fiscais, atendendo de forma proativa às necessidades dos nossos clientes.

O foco de sua atuação será no enquadramento tributário (aspecto crítico para as empresas) e execução dos processos de apuração pertinentes ao setor. Isso envolve um profundo entendimento e aplicação das legislação, assegurando que a organização atenda a todas as suas responsabilidades tributárias de forma eficiente e em total conformidade com o fisco.

Principais responsabilidades

  1. Atendimento aos clientes, solucionando problemas relacionados a impostos, tributação e notas fiscais, esclarecendo dúvidas e realizando as correções necessárias.
  2. Validar informações cruciais para garantir que os processos de outros departamentos que dependem do setor fiscal sejam executados corretamente.
  3. Garantir a precisão nas rotinas e processos fiscais, realizando validações em sistemas internos e reduzindo riscos aos clientes.
  4. Investigar as causas de problemas como indisponibilizações de guias e erros de tributação, visando correções e prevenção de recorrências.
  5. Acompanhar mudanças em prazos e novas regulamentações tributárias, consultando legislações de órgãos federais, estaduais e municipais, para garantir entregas corretas e dentro dos prazos.
  6. Manter-se em constante atualização.

Requisitos

  • Experiência mínima de 3 anos no setor fiscal;
  • Formação: Ciências Contábeis ou áreas afins (completo ou em curso);
  • Conhecimento da legislação tributária do Lucro Presumido e do Lucro Real - comércio e serviços;
  • Conhecimento sobre emissão de notas fiscais;
  • Conhecimento em apuração de tributos e cumprimento das obrigações acessórias pertinentes ao setor;
  • Habilidade com pacote Office;
  • Conhecimento em sistemas de contabilidade (Domínio Thomson Reuters será considerado um diferencial).

Habilidades e atitudes fundamentais

  • Foco no cliente
  • Autonomia
  • Proatividade
  • Gestão de tempo
  • Planejamento
  • Desenvolvimento contínuo
  • Organização pessoal
  • Adepto a mudanças

Clearances including Pennsylvania State Police Criminal Record Check, Child Abuse History, FBI background check, and completion of Protecting God's Children and Mandated Reporter Training.

Frequent standing, walking, sitting, and interaction with staff and students. Occasional lifting up to 25 pounds. Work hours are Monday-Friday, 8 AM to 4 PM, with potential for additional hours for meetings and events.

title: Pre-Sales Data Scientist - 218910
description:
Our Company

At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. That’s why we built the most complete cloud analytics and data platform for AI. By delivering harmonized data, trusted AI, and faster innovation, we uplift and empower our customers and our customers’ customers to make better, more confident decisions. The world’s top companies across every major industry trust Teradata to improve business performance, enrich customer experiences, and fully integrate data across the enterprise.

What You’ll Do

The Senior Data Scientist (pre-sales) is an experienced and expert Data Scientist, able to provide industry thought-leadership on Analytics and its application across industries and across use-cases. The Senior Data Scientist supports the account team in framing business problems and in identifying analytic solutions that leverage Teradata technology and that are disruptive, innovative - and above all, practical. An articulate and compelling communicator, the Senior Data Scientist establishes our position as an important partner for advanced analytics with customers and prospects and is a trusted advisor to executives, senior managers and fellow data scientists alike across a range of target accounts. They are also a hands-on practitioner who is ready, willing and able to roll-up her sleeves and to deliver POC and short-term pre-sales engagements. The Senior Data Scientist has an excellent theoretical and practical understanding of statistics and machine learning and has a strong track record of applying this understanding at scale to drive business benefit. They are insanely curious and is a natural problem-solver and able to effectively promote Teradata technology and solutions to our customers.

Who You’ll Work With

The successful candidate will work with other expert team members to:

  1. Provide pre-sales support at an executive level to the Teradata account teams, helping them to position and sell complex Analytic solutions that drive sales of Teradata software.
  2. Provide strategic pre-sales consulting to executives and senior managers in our target market.
  3. Support the delivery of PoC and PoV projects that demonstrate the viability and applicability of Analytic use-cases and the superiority of Teradata solutions and services.
  4. Work with the extended Account team, and Sales Analytics Specialists to develop new Analytic propositions that are aligned with industry trends and customer requirements.

What Makes You a Qualified Candidate

  1. A degree level qualification (preferably Masters or PHD) in Statistics, Data Science, the physical or biological sciences or a related discipline.
  2. Proven hands-on experience of complex analytics at scale for example in the areas of IoT and sensor data.
  3. Understanding of the PMML and ONNX model portability standards.
  4. Experience with Teradata partner’s analytical products, Cloud Service providers such as AzureML and Sagemaker and partner products such as Dataiku and H2O.
  5. Strong hands-on programming skills in at least one major analytic programming language and/or tool in addition to SQL.

What You’ll Bring

  1. Expertise in Data Science with a strong theoretical grounding in statistics, advanced analytics, and machine learning and at least 5 years real-world experience in the application of advanced analytics.
  2. A passion about knowledge sharing and demonstrate a commitment to continuous professional development.
  3. A belief in Teradata's Analytic solutions and services and a commitment to working with the product, engineering, and consulting teams to ensure that they continue to lead the market.
  4. An ability to turn complex technical subject matter into relatable, easy to digest and understand content for senior audiences.

Why We Think You’ll Love Teradata

We prioritize a people-first culture because we know our people are at the very heart of our success. We embrace a flexible work model because we trust our people to make decisions about how, when, and where they work. We focus on well-being because we care about our people and their ability to thrive both personally and professionally. We are an anti-racist company because our dedication to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion is more than a statement. It is a deep commitment to doing the work to foster an equitable environment that celebrates people for all of who they are.

O Grupo Patrimar não para de crescer e, atualmente, está entre os mais modernos e eficientes do país, tanto em estrutura e equipamentos quanto em know-how e versatilidade.

Somos Todos Instituto

Fundado em 2008, o Instituto de Responsabilidade Social Sírio-Libanês (IRSSL) nasceu com o propósito de fortalecer a atuação social voluntária da Sociedade Beneficente de Senhoras do Hospital Sírio-Libanês na saúde pública do Brasil, tendo como missão levar a excelência administrativa e operacional, já reconhecida no setor privado, às esferas municipais e estaduais do País.

O Instituto administra atualmente 13 unidades de saúde: Hospital Municipal Infantil Menino Jesus, Hospital Geral do Grajaú, Hospital Regional de Jundiaí, Hospital Regional de Registro, Hospital Regional Rota dos Bandeirantes (Barueri), Hospital Geral de Taipas, Hospital Geral de Vila Penteado, AME Interlagos, AME Jundiaí, AMAS, Ambulatório de Gratuidades, Núcleo de Saúde da Fundação Lia Maria Aguiar, Serviço de Reabilitação Lucy Montoro de Mogi Mirim.

Nosso propósito

Compartilhar a excelência na saúde pública com relevância social.

Nossa visão

Ser uma organização social protagonista na jornada de excelência em saúde com responsabilidade social no Brasil.

Nossos valores

Solidariedade, Excelência, Resultado.

Descubra mais sobre nós clicando no link abaixo.


Main responsibilities

  1. Responsável por gerir o parque de equipamentos da unidade, visando garantir a disponibilidade dos equipamentos para a área Assistencial, garantindo a segurança de pacientes e usuários e a sustentabilidade.
  2. Acompanhar em campo as atividades da equipe técnica de engenharia de manutenção.
  3. Acompanhar a aplicação de treinamento junto à equipe assistencial e técnica.

  5. Participar dos projetos de infraestrutura hospitalar tais como: edificação (projeto, construção e manutenção), instalações (elétrica, hidráulica, HVAC, gases medicinais, etc.), obras e reformas (predial e instalações).
  6. Replicar a utilização do sistema de gestão, criando regras e apoiando na gestão da área de manutenção Hospitalar, dentre demais atividades.
  7. Acompanhar as atividades da equipe de manutenção, realizando conferência dos serviços realizados e indicando/orientando não conformidades nas atividades.

Requirements and skills

  1. Graduação em áreas correlatas.
  2. Sistema de gestão de OS.

title: Senior Cloud Security Engineer
description:
1GLOBAL is a technology-driven global mobile communications provider dedicated to empowering enterprises worldwide to unlock the full growth potential of mobile connectivity. With a best-in-class telecom technology platform, a comprehensive suite of globally viable regulatory licenses, and privileged access to the telecom wholesale market, 1GLOBAL is uniquely positioned to deliver seamless compliance and connectivity solutions. Serving the world’s leading banks, corporations, and digital-first businesses—including neo-banks, travel companies, and payment service providers—1GLOBAL connects over 43 million devices globally.


With 2024 full-year revenue exceeding US$100 million, 1GLOBAL is a profitable business generating significant cash flows to fund its ongoing investments in infrastructure, transformation, and growth. 2024 saw major client wins and marked 1GLOBAL’s evolution from a multi-market telecommunication provider to a global technology-driven mobile connectivity powerhouse.


Established in 2022 by experienced tech founders and entrepreneurs Hakan Koç and Pyrros Koussios, 1GLOBAL is a European technology leader driving digital transformation in the global telecommunications market. It operates as a fully regulated Mobile Virtual Network Operator (“MVNO”) in nine countries and as a regulated telecommunications operator in an additional 31 countries. Headquartered in the Netherlands, with world-class R&D hubs in Lisbon, Berlin, and São Paulo, 1GLOBAL employs over 400 experts across 13 countries.

Position Overview

We are looking for a talentedSenior DevSecOps / Cloud Security Engineer to join our Technology Department, with a focus on strengthening and automating our security posture across cloud and hybrid infrastructure.

We are open to hiring this role inLisbon, Portugal , orSão Paulo, Brazil.

As a DevSecOps /Cloud Security Engineer, you will be responsible for embedding security into every stage of our infrastructure lifecycle, from design to deployment. You will lead the implementation of cloud-native security controls in AWS, harden Kubernetes environments, and drive best practices across CI/CD pipelines. Your role includes continuous vulnerability management, network protection, monitoring for threats, and working with development, DevOps and IP teams to ensure secure-by-default practices. You’ll also proactively identify risks, secure network perimeters, and automate remediation wherever possible.

A new hire in Sao Paulo would spend their first week in Lisbon/Berlin for onboarding.

Key responsibilities

  • Design and implement scalable cloud security controls in AWS multi-account environments
  • Lead Kubernetes security architecture, including PodSecurity, RBAC, and network policies
  • Enforcezero trust network architecture and secure segmentation across cloud and hybrid environments
  • Integrate security automation into CI/CD pipelines (image scanning, SAST, IaC analysis)
  • Deploy and manage CrowdStrike, Tenable, and similar endpoint and vulnerability management tools
  • Continuously monitor infrastructure for vulnerabilities, threats, and misconfigurations
  • Enforce least privilege IAM policies and secure secrets management
  • Conduct regular audits, penetration testing, and hardening of cloud workloads and host systems
  • Conductnetwork traffic inspection using tools like VPC Flow Logs, packet capture, or NetFlow
  • Collaborate with DevOps and IP teams on security-as-code principles
  • Maintain compliance with internal policies and external standards (e.g. CIS, NIST, ISO 27001)
  • Tune and respond to alerts from WAF, IDS/IPS, and SIEM systems
  • Document security controls, incident response playbooks, and operational runbooks
  • Champion a security-first culture through collaboration, training, and awareness

Minimum Qualifications

  • A minimum of 5 years in DevSecOps, Cloud Security, or Infrastructure Security roles
  • Strong expertise in AWS security services (IAM, KMS, GuardDuty, Config, Security Hub, etc.)
  • In-depth understanding ofnetwork security principles (firewalls, routing, segmentation, VPNs, IPsec, etc.)
  • Proven hands-on experience with Kubernetes security (RBAC, NetworkPolicies, OPA/Gatekeeper, Admission Controllers)
  • Experience operating CrowdStrike Falcon and Tenable Nessus / Tenable.io
  • Experience with WAFs, DDoS protection,NIDS/NIPS, and threat intelligence integrations
  • Comfortable withpacket inspection, flow analysis, and traffic monitoring (tcpdump, Wireshark, Suricata, etc.)
  • Proficiency in Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Terragrunt) and configuration management (Ansible, Packer)
  • Strong scripting/programming skills (Python, Go, or Bash) for automation and tooling
  • Solid understanding of Linux security hardening and secure cloud networking
  • Familiarity with service mesh security in Istio or similar
  • Experience with GitOps workflows using tools like Argo CD or Flux
  • Understanding of vulnerability management, secure software development lifecycle (SSDLC), and security controls for containers
  • Exposure to compliance frameworks like ISO 27001, SOC2, NIST, PCI-DSS is a plus
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with a proactive mindset
  • Certifications such as AWS Certified Security Specialty, CKS, OSCP, or CISSP is a plus
  • Experience with multi-cloud security (Azure/GCP)
  • Background in ethical hacking, bug bounty programs, or red teaming
  • Familiarity with tools like Falco, Sysdig, Trivy, or eBPF-based runtime security tools

Why 1GLOBAL?

  • Growth Opportunities: Advance your career in one of the fastest growing telecommunications companies, expanding over 40% year-on-year under the leadership of successful tech entrepreneurs.
  • Major Transaction Exposure: Be in the driver’s seat for transactions that will have an impact on the future telco industry.
  • Work with a Talented Team: From the Board and the Founders to the Senior Management Team, you will collaborate daily with the most capable and renowned external advisors, and constantly being exposed to talented and driven individuals.
  • Dynamic Work Environment: Thrive in a collaborative, fast-paced workplace where innovation is encouraged, and every contribution counts.
  • Professional Development: Work alongside industry experts to enhance your skills and knowledge in a cutting-edge field.
  • International Experience: Gain opportunities to work in different 1GLOBAL offices around the world as you grow within the company.
  • Open Communication Culture: Join a team where your ideas are heard, and open dialogue is encouraged, fostering a supportive and transparent work environment.
  • Get Things Done Attitude: Be part of a results-driven team that values efficiency, creativity, and the drive to make a tangible impact in the industry.


1GLOBAL is an equal opportunity employer, we value your character as much as your talent. Diversity drives our innovation, and we offer a collaborative, dynamic, and international work environment. We are excited for you to join our mission to revolutionise connectivity globally.

description:
Why join us

TRACTIAN is transforming the industrial world by empowering frontline maintenance workers to achieve more. We’ve fused cutting-edge hardware with innovative software into one powerful platform, disrupting legacy systems and delivering smarter, faster solutions for our clients.

At TRACTIAN, you'll break boundaries, question convention, and collaborate with top talent to drive real change. As a part of our growth-stage startup, you’ll work alongside the founders, shaping the vision, products, and experiences that will define the future of industrial tech.

Software at TRACTIAN

The software department at TRACTIAN is at the forefront of innovation, crafting an integrated ecosystem that revolutionizes maintenance and process management. Comprising a dynamic team of experts, the department develops an all-in-one software solution that seamlessly combines predictive maintenance capabilities with a comprehensive Computerized Maintenance Management System (CMMS). This visionary approach empowers maintenance and process teams with a unified platform, enabling them to proactively predict equipment failures, optimize maintenance workflows, and enhance operational efficiency. In daily work, the software department drives the convergence of cutting-edge technology and maintenance excellence to propel businesses toward unparalleled success.

What you'll do

As a Staff Frontend Software Engineer , your role will focus on the development and enhancement of key features for our Web applications. You will be responsible for creating and refining features that are both user-centric and...

Responsibilities

  • Work with engineers & technical leaders across the company to ship products on strong foundations.

  • Develop and lead the team to execute against both short-term and long-term roadmaps.

  • Identify, scope, and lead large technical projects, laying the groundwork for early-stage products to iteratively evolve and scale, and taming complexity and shoring up reliability of existing systems.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • 5+ years of experience in front-end development, with a minimum of 3 years dedicated to React.

  • Experience in implementing caching strategies or asynchronous state management for high data load applications.
  • Strong knowledge in web performance optimization and cross-platform compatibility.
  • Experience working across engineering teams and other functions in building alignment, driving decision-making, and communicating transparently. Experience mentoring and helping in the development of engineers and peers.

Bonus points

  • Track record of leading frontend platform development in a high-growth tech environment.
  • Experience in creating offline applications or desktop applications using Electron/Tauri.
  • Experience in high-volume data processing.
  • Fluent in English.

  • Health plan with national coverage and without coparticipation

  • Apoiar a liderança imediata em questões relacionadas à área de atuação, identificando problemas, sugerindo soluções e fornecendo informações que ajudem a melhorar a produtividade e o alcance das metas da área.

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing.
We are hiring a Site Reliability Engineer
Next-gen operations at scale, with pure Python infra-as-code, from bare metal to containers and applications. Our goal is to perfect enterprise infrastructure devops.
We run hundreds of private cloud, Kubernetes, and application clusters for customers across physical and public cloud estate, and we are raising the bar on what's possible with automation by embracing a universal operator pattern and model-driven operations.
To succeed in this role you need to believe in automation as a pure software engineering problem, not a hack-it-till-it-works-for-me problem. You need to be interested in the scientific approach to operations at scale, driven by metrics and code, and you need to be able to learn the entire stack, from bare metal networking and kernel up to serverless and open source applications.
Location: Globally remote role
The role entails
Our cloud operations engineers bring Python software-engineering skills and rigour to the operations domain. We practise devsecops from bare metal to application. We architect and run OpenStack, Kubernetes and software defined storage, and we enable devsecops for applications running on that infrastructure too.
To become a member of this team, you need to be a software engineer fluent in Python, you need a genuine interest in the full open source infrastructure stack from metal to containers, and you need the ability to work in a high pressure operations environment with mission-critical services for global brand name customers.
As a member of the team you will gain experience in a broad range of cloud technologies. We evolve our offerings as the state of the art improves, so you get to stay current with the latest capabilities in open source infrastructure. We drive upgrades to keep our customers on the latest, best solutions.
What we are looking for in you

  • Degree in Software Engineering or Computer Science
  • Experience with Linux and familiarity with Linux networking and storage
  • Python software development expertise
  • Operational experience
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year, for company events up to two weeks long
Nice-to-have skills
  • Experience with OpenStack or Kubernetes deployment or operations
  • Familiarity with public or private cloud management
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Our People & Talent department at Sporty is the beating heart of our operation. Working with us is challenging and rewarding; we offer great opportunities for good team fits. We aim to offer real value and benefit to our People and the Company. A proactive, positive working attitude and solutions-driven mindset is essential to work in this lean and vital area of our organisation.

Who We Are

Sporty Group is a consumer internet and technology business with an unrivalled sports media, gaming, social and fintech platform which serves millions of daily active users across the globe via technology and operations hubs across more than 10 countries and 3 continents.

The recipe for our success is to discover intelligent and energetic people, who are passionate about our products and serving our users, and attract and retain them with a dynamic and flexible work life which empowers them to create value and rewards them generously based upon their contribution.

Candidate Profile

We are seeking an experienced IT Engineer to take care of our IT needs and provide awesome support to our employees. This is an opportunity to flex your technical muscles daily by gaining exposure to a variety of IT systems, cloud services, and cutting-edge technology in a fast-paced and exciting industry. You will also have the chance to expand your domain knowledge into global IT and security.

Responsibilities

  1. Provide technical assistance, advice, and training to users, resolve issues at the tier one level, and escalate issues to the appropriate escalation team.
  2. Install, configure, and provision computer hardware, software, and peripherals.
  3. Oversee deployment and maintenance of IT systems, ensuring optimal and reliable operations.
  4. Manage and maintain company IT assets and systemic inventory.
  5. Be a liaison for compliance with statutory requirements imposed by the Data Protection Act.
  6. Develop the completion of data protection documentation using the Data Capability Assurance framework.
  7. Empower and support business groups demonstrating their compliance during audits.
  8. Administer corporate telecom/network systems, including topology, configuration, design, and security.
  9. Research and recommend technologies and best practices approaches for our environment.
  10. Assist with Global IT and Security projects.
  11. Maintain essential IT operations, including operating systems, security tools, VPN gateways, email systems, laptops, desktops, software, and hardware.
  12. Procure and manage devices, including laptops and other IT assets.
  13. Handle IT asset allocations at the time of joining and exits, both virtually and in-person.
  14. Create, manage, and deactivate email IDs, user accounts, Office Automation, and Security tools.
  15. Monitor system performance and troubleshoot hardware and software issues.
  16. Lead IT helpdesk to support employees, ensuring all desktop applications, workstations, and related equipment problems are resolved promptly with limited disruptions.
  17. Maintain, repair, and upgrade systems and processes, including hardware and software programs.

Skills and Qualification Requirements

  1. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, System Administration, or a closely related field.
  2. 5+ years of relevant experience in IT systems, network administration, and related technologies.
  3. Proficiency with firewalls, SDN, and network routing.
  4. Advanced knowledge of network technology and security principles.
  5. Advanced knowledge of SSO, MDM, and system provisioning in Windows, Mac, and Linux systems.
  6. Advanced knowledge in managing cloud IT services and security.
  7. Understanding and knowledge of the Data Protection Acts.
  8. Articulate complex data law requirements in a clear and user-friendly way/format.
  9. Strong knowledge of systems and networking, and the ability to effectively use computerized solutions.
  10. Working knowledge of Windows, Linux, and Mac operating systems.
  11. Solid knowledge of best practices in IT administration, system vulnerabilities, and security.
  12. Ability to think critically, analyze root causes, diagnose problems, and provide solutions.
  13. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
  14. Ability to work independently and take end-to-end accountability for employee IT issues.
  15. Should be flexible with work from office (Sao Paulo, Brazil).

Benefits

  1. Performance-based quarterly bonus.
  2. Referral bonus.
  3. IT Asset provided.
  4. 28 days paid annual leave.
  5. Annual company retreat.
  6. Highly talented, dependable co-workers in a global, multicultural organization.
  7. Our teams are small enough for you to be impactful.
  8. Our business is globally established and successful, offering stability and security to our Team Members.

Our Mission

Our mission is to be an everyday entertainment platform for everyone.

Our Operating Principles

  1. Create Value for Users.
  2. Act in the Long-Term Interests of Sporty.
  3. Focus on Product Improvements & Innovation.
  4. Be Responsible.
  5. Preserve Integrity & Honesty.
  6. Respect Confidentiality & Privacy.
  7. Ensure Stability, Security & Scalability.
  8. Work Hard with Passion & Pride.

Interview Process

  1. 30 min Aptitude Test.
  2. Remote video screening with our Talent Acquisition Team.
  3. Remote 90 min video interview loop with 3 x Team Members (30 mins each).
  4. 24-72 hour feedback loops throughout the process.

Working at Sporty

The top-down mentality at Sporty is high performance-based, meaning we trust you to do your job with an emphasis on support to help you achieve, grow and de-block any issues when they're in your way. Generally, employees can choose their own hours, as long as they are collaborating and doing stand-ups etc. The emphasis is really on results.

As we are a highly structured and established company, we are able to offer the security and support of a global business with the allure of a startup environment. Sporty is independently managed and financed, meaning we don’t have arbitrary shareholder or VC targets to cater to.

We literally build, spend and make decisions based on the ethos of building THE best platform of its kind. We are truly a tech company to the core and take excellent care of our Team Members.

EBANX es la plataforma de pagos líder que conecta a empresas globales con clientes de los mercados digitales de más rápido crecimiento en el mundo.

Desde el comienzo de nuestro viaje, hemos tenido una misión importante: brindar acceso global . ¡Creemos que transformar desafíos en oportunidades y hacer que lo imposible sea parte del viaje es crucial! Es precisamente por eso que creamos una tecnología de pagos que construye puentes entre personas y empresas todos los días en 29 mercados emergentes en todo el mundo.

Somos los ebankers, somos pensadores globales, valoramos la diversidad, fomentamos la creatividad y trabajamos arduamente para conectar empresas y personas en todo el mundo a través de los pagos. ¿Quieres hacer historia con nosotros?

Buscamos a un Analista Contable SR que enfoque en mejoras constantes, sea cuestionador, tenga actitud positiva y sea dueño de sus actividades. Te tiene que gustar algunas rutinas, tener un buen raciocinio lógico y habilidad para trabajar con personas de diversas áreas de EBANX y asociados.

Esta posición tiene enfoque en operaciones contables de los asociados localizadas en América Latina, o sea, habrá un desafío internacional muy grande en tus manos, una convivencia diaria con proveedores de servicios, profesionales locales, presentaciones, reportes y reuniones en español y portugués. El profesional ejecutará rutinas diarias de contabilidad y cierre contable mensual de empresas internacionales, con apoyo de proveedores de servicios locales.

Además de querer conquistar el mundo, sus actividades serán:

  • Registros/pólizas y clasificación contable;
  • Análisis y control de todas las cuentas contables – activo, pasivo, costos, gastos y utilidades;

  • Cierre de balances/estados financieros y preparo de reportes;
  • Organización de documentos contables y fiscales;
  • Asegurar los controles y obligaciones locales;
  • Soportar y acompañar los trabajos de las auditorías externas y consultorías, prestando soporte necesario, considerando agilidad y calidad del trabajo de los proveedores de servicios locales.

¿Qué es indispensable para la vacante?

  • Español nativo;
  • Ser graduado en Contaduría o Administración/Economía estudiando Contaduría;
  • Experiencia en empresas de gran porte o medianas;
  • Conocimiento en rutinas contables y fiscales;
  • Conocimiento en IFRS;
  • Conocimiento avanzado en Excel;
  • Necesitamos personas que sepan trabajar con autonomía y tengan capacidad técnica para no trabar la operación;

¿Qué más nos gustaría ver?

  • Haber actuado en contabilidad internacional y/o actuado en operaciones locales de América Latina;
  • Experiencia en medios de pago, servicios de adquirentes, instituciones de pagos, productos financieros, productos digitales y e-commerce;
  • Persistencia, compromiso, conocimiento y enfoque en resultados;
  • Tener un buen gerenciamiento de tiempo, priorización de actividades y autonomía.

Join to apply for the Python and Kubernetes Software Engineer - Data, Workflows, AI/ML & Analytics role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1000+ colleagues in 70+ countries and very few roles based in offices. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing. We are hiring Python and Kubernetes Specialist Engineers focused on Data, Workflows, AI/ML and Analytics Solutions to join our teams building open source solutions for public cloud and private infrastructure.
As a software engineer on the team, you'll collaborate on end-to-end data analytics and MLOps solutions composed of popular, open-source, machine learning tools, such as Kubeflow, MLFlow, DVC, and Feast. You may also work on ETL, data governance and visualization tools like Apache SuperSet, dbt, workflow orchestration tools such as Airflow and Temporal, or data warehouse solutions such as Apache Trino, or ClickHouse. These solutions may be run on servers or on the cloud, on machines or on Kubernetes, on developer desktops, or as web services.
We serve the needs of individuals and community members as much as the needs of our Global 2000 and Fortune 500 customers; we make our primary work available free of charge and our Pro subscriptions are also available to individuals for personal use at no cost. Our goal is to enable more people to enjoy the benefits of open source, regardless of their circumstances.
Location: This initiative spans many teams that are home-based and in multiple time zones. We believe in distributed collaboration but we also try to ensure that colleagues have company during their work hours! Successful candidates will join a team where most members and your manager are broadly in the same time zone so that you have the benefits of constant collaboration and discussion.
What your day will look like

  • Develop your understanding of the entire Linux stack, from kernel, networking, and storage, to the application layer
  • Design, build and maintain solutions that will be deployed on public and private clouds and local workstations
  • Master distributed systems concepts such as observability, identity, tracing
  • Work with both Kubernetes and machine-oriented open source applications
  • Collaborate proactively with a distributed team of engineers, designers and product managers
  • Debug issues and interact in public with upstream and Ubuntu communities
  • Generate and discuss ideas, and collaborate on finding good solutions
What we are looking for in you
  • Professional or academic software delivery using Python
  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in a technical subject or a compelling narrative about your alternative chosen path
  • Confidence to respectfully speak up, exchange feedback, and share ideas without hesitation
  • Track record of going above-and-beyond expectations to achieve outstanding results
  • Passion for technology evidenced by personal projects and initiatives
  • The work ethic and confidence to shine alongside motivated colleagues
  • Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills
  • Experience with Linux (Debian or Ubuntu preferred)
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
  • Appreciative of diversity, polite and effective in a multi-cultural, multi-national organisation
  • Thoughtfulness and self-motivation
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • Ability to travel twice a year, for company events up to two weeks long
Additional skills that would be nice to have
The following skills may be helpful to you in the role, but we don't expect everyone to bring all of them.
  • Proven track record of building highly automated machine learning solutions, data pipelines, or orchestrating workflows for the cloud.
  • Hands-on experience with machine learning libraries, or tools.
  • Experience with container technologies (Docker, LXD, Kubernetes, etc.)
  • Experience with public clouds (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud)
  • Working knowledge of cloud computing
  • Passionate about software quality and testing
  • Experience working on an open source project
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer
description:
Join to apply for the Senior Site Reliability Engineer role at Canonical

1 day ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Senior Site Reliability Engineer role at Canonical

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing.
We are hiring a Senior Site Reliability Engineer
Next-gen operations at scale, with pure Python infra-as-code, from bare metal to containers and applications. Our goal is to perfect enterprise infrastructure devops.
We run hundreds of private cloud, Kubernetes, and application clusters for customers across physical and public cloud estate, and we are raising the bar on what's possible with automation by embracing a universal operator pattern and model-driven operations.
To succeed in this role you need to believe in automation as a pure software engineering problem, not a hack-it-till-it-works-for-me problem. You need to be interested in the scientific approach to operations at scale, driven by metrics and code, and you need to be able to learn the entire stack, from bare metal networking and kernel up to serverless and open source applications.
Location: Globally remote role
The role entails
Our cloud operations engineers bring Python software-engineering skills and rigour to the operations domain. We practise devsecops from bare metal to application. We architect and run OpenStack, Kubernetes and software defined storage, and we enable devsecops for applications running on that infrastructure too.
To become a member of this team, you need to be a software engineer fluent in Python, you need a genuine interest in the full open source infrastructure stack from metal to containers, and you need the ability to work in a high pressure operations environment with mission-critical services for global brand name customers.
As a member of the team you will gain experience in a broad range of cloud technologies. We evolve our offerings as the state of the art improves, so you get to stay current with the latest capabilities in open source infrastructure. We drive upgrades to keep our customers on the latest, best solutions.
What we are looking for in you

  • Degree in Software Engineering or Computer Science
  • Experience with Linux and familiarity with Linux networking and storage
  • Python software development expertise
  • Operational experience
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year, for company events up to two weeks long
Nice-to-have skills
  • Experience with OpenStack or Kubernetes deployment or operations
  • Familiarity with public or private cloud management
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

O trabalho é realizado em times colaborativos, totalmente focados em atingir os melhores resultados para cada cliente. Utilizamos metodologias ágeis e nossos Engenheiros e Engenheiras de Software possuem perfil full stack, trabalhando na plataforma SYDLE ONE.

As tecnologias utilizadas são: Javascript, Elasticsearch, React, API REST, entre outras.

Gostou da oportunidade? Entenda nossa seleção.

Ao cadastrar seu currículo, ele será analisado pelo nosso RH e, caso seja selecionado, entraremos em contato com você para informar sobre a nossa seleção - que ocorrerá em três etapas (Teste de Lógica, Bate-papo RH e Bate-papo Técnico). Portanto, verifique se seu contato no currículo está atualizado e confira sempre seu e-mail e telefone :)

Uma LEVTY para todos!

Entendemos que a inovação só nasce com a diversidade e sabemos da importância de cada um para a construção de um ambiente de trabalho autêntico e plural. Por isso, todas as nossas vagas, sem exceção, são abertas para todas as pessoas, e nossa seleção será adaptada de acordo com a necessidade de cada um!

Confira nossos benefícios!

Uma cesta de benefícios pensada para você!

Sabemos que pessoas diferentes possuem necessidades diferentes. Por isso, não há sentido em engessar nossos benefícios! Nos preocupamos em proporcionar um pacote com incentivos variados, para que cada colaborador usufrua da forma mais adequada à sua realidade!

Job description

A Rezende Caminhões está em busca de profissionais para o departamento da oficina. Um pintor de autos é um profissional especializado no processo de pintura e retocar a pintura de veículos automotivos.

Principais informações:

  • Vaga: Pintor de Autos
  • Salário da categoria: R$2.385,02
  • Unidade: Rezende Caminhões - Central Implementos
  • Cidade: Manaus, AM
  • Carga Horária: 44 horas semanais
  • Contrato: CLT

Main responsibilities

  • Preparação da Superfície: Antes de pintar, o pintor deve preparar a superfície do veículo/Equipamento. Isso pode envolver a remoção da pintura antiga, lixar, preencher depressões ou danos na carroceria com massa, e aplicar um primer.
  • Seleção e Mistura de Tintas: Com base na necessidade do veículo, o pintor seleciona a tinta adequada e, frequentemente, precisa misturá-la para obter a cor exata.
  • Aplicação da Tinta: Usando pistolas de pulverização e técnicas específicas, o pintor aplica a tinta de forma uniforme na superfície do veículo.
  • Aplicação de Acabamentos: Após a pintura, pode ser necessário aplicar lacas ou outros acabamentos para proteger a pintura e dar-lhe um brilho específico.
  • Inspeção de Qualidade: Após a pintura, o profissional verifica o trabalho para garantir que não haja imperfeições e que o acabamento esteja de alta qualidade.
  • Manutenção e Limpeza: O pintor é responsável por limpar e manter as ferramentas e o espaço de trabalho, garantindo que tudo esteja em ordem para os próximos trabalhos.

Requirements and skills

  • Ensino Médio completo
  • Habilidade em técnicas de pintura e uso de equipamentos relacionados.
  • Conhecimento das propriedades e aplicações de tintas e acabamentos automotivos.
  • Capacidade de misturar e combinar cores com precisão.
  • Atenção aos detalhes para garantir acabamentos de alta qualidade.
  • Conhecimento sobre práticas de segurança ao lidar com produtos químicos e equipamentos de pintura. Capacidade de trabalhar em ambientes potencialmente tóxicos, usando equipamentos de proteção adequados.

Additional information

  • Vale-Transporte ou Vale Combustível (Eucard)
  • Vale Refeição (Eucard)
  • Convênio com Drogaria

O isaac é a maior plataforma de soluções financeiras feita para escolas. Impulsionamos as instituições oferecendo receita garantida e proporcionando mais flexibilidade de pagamento para as famílias.

Nosso objetivo é facilitar a gestão financeira, acabando com a dor de cabeça e permitindo que a escola consiga focar na missão de educar , dedicando mais tempo e recursos para tirar os planos do papel.

Nos últimos 4 anos, já ajudamos mais de 2.000 escolas, garantimos mais de R$5bi em mensalidades garantidas, e ajudamos a aumentar em 9% o número de matrículas em nossas escolas parceiras.

A cultura do isaac incentiva a autonomia, a mão na massa, o trabalho em equipe e o uso de dados para construir soluções inovadoras.

Temos muito para construir e transformar na Educação brasileira, e você pode fazer parte dessa revolução, vivenciando o impacto do seu trabalho na sociedade!

Vem com a gente?

No dia a dia você irá:

  • Liderar o time de Pricing Ops, garantindo a escalabilidade dos processos e a qualidade das precificações.
  • Responder pelas métricas da área, como monitoramento de lead time, uso de políticas vs. modelos e taxas de inadimplência.
  • Gerenciar o processo de decisão de inadimplência para renovações, alinhando estratégias e assegurando a aderência às políticas internas.
  • Atuar diretamente com stakeholders estratégicos da área, buscando melhorias contínuas, promovendo alinhamentos e oferecendo treinamentos quando necessário.
  • Garantir o alinhamento entre processos, equipe e stakeholders, com foco em eficiência e entrega de resultados.

Para participar do nosso processo você precisa ter:

  • Experiência prévia trabalhando com metas e KPIs.
  • Experiência em liderança de times, preferencialmente de maior porte ou com alta complexidade em gestão de stakeholders.
  • Excel avançado, com habilidade para análises e modelagens de dados.
  • Excelente capacidade de comunicação estratégica, com clareza e foco em soluções.
  • Atenção a detalhes e habilidade para a escuta ativa.
  • Organização, pensamento crítico e habilidade para gerenciar prioridades em ambientes de alta pressão.

Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com fraude e risco, com visão crítica sobre estratégias para mitigar impactos.
  • Experiência em empresas do mercado financeiro.
  • Experiência com melhoria de processos e gestão de projetos.

Benefícios:

  • Auxílio alimentação e/ou refeição (Flash - R$40,50/dia);
  • Auxílio home office no primeiro mês de trabalho (R$200,00);
  • Plano de saúde e odontológico Sulamérica sem mensalidade e com coparticipação;
  • Licença maternidade (180 dias) e paternidade (30 dias) estendida;
  • Auxílio creche para mamães e papais com filhos até 06 anos;
  • Cuidado com a saúde física para você e seus dependentes: parceria com a Wellhub (Gympass);
  • Incentivo à educação - parcerias com diversas instituições de ensino;
  • ArcoLab - plataforma de educação corporativa;
  • Desconto em passagens aéreas e hospedagens;
  • Férias flexíveis (antecipação de 15 dias de férias após 6 meses).

#MaisDiversidade

Acreditamos que em um ambiente diverso e inclusivo nossas pessoas serão mais felizes, engajadas e com mais chances de atingir o seu máximo potencial . Por isso, aqui no isaac - uma empresa do Grupo Arco Educação, respeitamos e valorizamos a igualdade de direito, reconhecemos as singularidades e acreditamos que todas as pessoas podem contribuir para o nosso propósito. #vemproisaac

Declaração de Privacidade e Proteção de Dados

Quando você se candidata a uma das nossas vagas para ser isaacker, você nos fornece vários dados pessoais.

Ao final do processo seletivo, armazenamos o seu currículo em um banco de currículos, para o caso de surgirem novas vagas que tenham aderência ao seu perfil.

Para saber mais informações sobre como tratamos os seus dados e para exercer os seus direitos, acesse a nossa Declaração de Privacidade, disponível aqui.

description:
About the job Senior C++ / Java Developer

Overview:

We are looking for an experienced Senior C++ / Java Developer with a proven track record in building and optimizing high-performance backend systems for low-latency video streaming applications. You will play a key role in designing, developing, and optimizing systems that power next-generation streaming technologies.

Hard Skills:
Programming:

  • Strong proficiency in C++ (C++11/14/17) and Java 8/11.
    Solid understanding of data structures, algorithms, and system design principles.
    Video Streaming Expertise:
    Hands-on experience with WebRTC, RTMP, HLS, or similar streaming protocols.
    Familiarity with video codecs such as H.264, H.265, or VP9.
  • Experience building scalable microservices using frameworks like Spring Boot or gRPC.
    Knowledge of networking principles (TCP/IP, UDP, HTTP/2).
    Performance Optimization:
    Proven experience using tools for profiling and debugging (e.g., Perf, GDB, JProfiler).
    Understanding of memory management, multithreading, and concurrency models.
  • Experience deploying applications to AWS, Google Cloud, or Azure.

Soft Skills:

  • Detail-Oriented: Focused approach to writing maintainable, error-free code.
  • Adaptability: Thrive in a fast-paced environment and stay up-to-date with new technologies.

Qualifications:

  • Minimum of 10 years in backend software development with significant exposure to C++ and Java.
  • At least 5 years working with latency-critical video streaming systems.
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent experience.

Através dessas ações, plantamos sementes para um mundo mais sustentável e justo.
